# Yorozu

> Yorozu is an end-to-end-encrypted chat channel for OpenClaw: a native app for iPhone, iPad and Mac that talks to your own OpenClaw agent.

OpenClaw runs the agent, sessions, memory and cron; Yorozu only carries messages.
Mac: macOS 15 or later. iPhone and iPad: on the App Store, iOS 18 or later. Needs your own OpenClaw Gateway. Open source, MIT.

## Website

- [Home](https://yorozu.yumi.to/): what Yorozu is, how to set it up and get the apps
- [Support](https://yorozu.yumi.to/support/): how to get help and what to include in a report
- [Privacy](https://yorozu.yumi.to/privacy/): what data Yorozu handles and where it goes
- [Terms](https://yorozu.yumi.to/terms/): terms of use

## Apps

- [iPhone and iPad](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6811274963): App Store listing
- [Mac](https://yorozu.yumi.to/mac): download the latest Mac app

- [Help MCP server](https://github.com/izyuumi/yorozu/blob/main/docs/help-mcp.md): read-only MCP server for AI agents
